title: N66001-26-Q- 6149? Notice of Intent to Sole Source to Research Electronics International (REI), LLC. (CAGE Code: 3Y543)
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.SPAWAR.SPAWAR PACIFIC.NIWC PACIFIC
detail_text: Department of the Navy, Naval Information Warfare Center Pacific (NIWC PACIFIC) hereby publicizes its intention to solicit, negotiate and award a commercial, firm-fixed-price purchase order on a non-competitive basis with REI, LLC. (CAGE 3Y543), Cookeville, Tennessee 38506-4941, United States. This is a purchase request for quantity 2 of REI Mesa 2.0 Deluxe Analyzer for testing and accurate results for the electronic warfare technology project.A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement based on responses to this notice is solely at the discretion of the Government. The applicable NAICS Code is 334515 and the business size standard is 750 employees. The applicable PSC code is 6625.This notice is not a request for competitive quotes; however, any responsible source believing that it can fulfill the requirement may submit a quote for consideration by the Government. Comments, questions or concerns regarding this notice may be submitted via e-mail to hannah.m.chichester.civ@us.navy.mil by 10:00 am PST on 11 May 2026. Questions by phone or fax will not be considered.To respond to this announcement, you must be registered to the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) Solicitation module at https://piee.eb.mil/xhtml/unauth/home/login.xhtml and upload your inquiry under NIWC Pacific/Simplified Acquisition N66001-26-Q-6149. Responding vendors must be registered to the System for Award Management (SAM) website www.sam.gov prior to award of the related order/contract. Registration means a registered UEI and active CAGE Code. Be advised that the aforementioned information is anticipatory in nature and is not binding. A copy of the Request for Quote will be made available upon request.Cognizant Contracting Office: NIWC Pacific, San Diego, CA. Contract Specialist: Hannah Chichester, hannah.m.chichester.civ@us.navy.mil Contracting Officer: Andrew Clark, andrew.s.clark20.civ@us.navy.mil
